steps.text: Head to the Canifis bar and either buy the pickled brain for 50 coins, or telegrab it.
Talk to Dr. Fenkenstrain to start the quest.
Go up the staircase to grab the items you will need.
Search the nearby bookcase for Handy Maggot Avoidance Techniques.
Search the west bookcase for The Joy of Grave Digging.
Combine the two amulet by using one on the other.
Go back to the ground floor.
Talk to the Gardener Ghost while wearing your Ghostspeak amulet.
Go to the grave of the gardener and dig for his head.
Use the decapitated head on the pickled brain to create a decapitated head.
Use the Star Amulet on the memorial and push it to go in the caves.
Push the memorial south east of the castle.
Kill the level 51 Experiment north-west of the ladder to get a key.
Pick up the key.
Leave the caves by going north-west, be sure to pick up the key from the level 51 experiment.
Use your spade on this tile to get the torso.
Use your spade on this tile to get arms.
Use your spade on this tile to get legs.
Deliver the body parts to Dr. Fenkenstrain, use a teleport to Fenkenstrain's castle or run back through the caves.
choices: I have some body parts for you.

steps.text: Get a needle and 5 threads and deliver them to Dr. Fenkenstrain.
Talk to the Gardener Ghost and ask for the shed key.
choices: Do you know where the key to the shed is?

steps.text: Open the cupboard and search it for a brush.
Grab 3 canes from the pile.
Use 3 canes on the brush one at a time.
Go up to the second floor of the castle.
Use the extended brush on the fireplace to get the conductor mould.
Go to any furnace make a lightning rod.
Return to the castle and go upstairs.
Go up to the third floor using the ladder in the middle of the castle.
Repair the lightning Conductor.
Go back to the first floor of the castle and talk to Dr. Fenkenstrain.
Go back to the first floor of the castle and talk to Dr. Fenkenstrain.
Go up to the second floor to confront Fenkenstrain's monster.
Use the Tower Key on the door.
Go up the ladder.
Talk to Fenkenstrain's monster.
Go back to Dr. Fenkenstrain, instead of talking to him right click and pickpocket him.
